description: This file defines locale-specific information for the DateJS library for Catalan (Catalan) language/Culture, version 1.0 Alpha-1. It includes cultural details such as day and month names, date/time formats, regex patterns for parsing dates, timezone info, and prototype methods for date manipulation tailored to the 'ca-ES' locale.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time component of the date to midnight (00:00:00.000).

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time of the date object to the current local time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates and returns a copy of the date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the current date object to another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: addMilliseconds
methods.description: Adds a specified number of milliseconds to the date.

methods.name: addSeconds
methods.description: Adds a specified number of seconds to the date.

methods.name: addMinutes
methods.description: Adds a specified number of minutes to the date.

methods.name: addHours
methods.description: Adds a specified number of hours to the date.

methods.name: addDays
methods.description: Adds a specified number of days to the date.

methods.name: addWeeks
methods.description: Adds a specified number of weeks to the date.

methods.name: addMonths
methods.description: Adds a specified number of months to the date.

methods.name: addYears
methods.description: Adds a specified number of years to the date.
